info.title: Prodlys API
info.description: Mobile API. Sign in with POST /api/auth/sign-in/email and send the `set-auth-token` response header as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tenant endpoints also need `X-Company-Id`. Success bodies are `{ data, meta? }`; errors are `{ error: { code, message, fields?, requestId } }`. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

get.summary: Bookings, deliveries, invoice due dates and receipts for a date range (layers need order:read, dispatch:read, invoice:read, payment:read)

schema.description: Last day, exclusive (India date); at most 62 days after from
Comma list of orders,deliveries,invoices,payments (default: every layer the role may see)

items.description: order: {number,status,customerName,startsAt,endsAt,dueDate,orderDate,total,received,balance,...}; delivery: {dispatchId,number,status,event,orderId,orderNumber,customerName,startsAt,dueDate}; invoice: {number,customerName,total,due,dueDate}; payments: {day,count,total,payments[]}. Money is a decimal string.

get.summary: Week, month or year over year: this period so far against the previous period and a year ago, with a 12-period trend

schema.description: Weeks are ISO (Monday first); a year is the calendar year, India time

previous.description: The slice compared against (same days into the previous period)

lastYear.description: The slice compared against (same days into the period a year ago)

basis.description: A flow adds up inside the period; a stock is a balance at its end

previous.description: The same number of days into the period before

lastYear.description: The same number of days into the same period a year earlier

abs.description: Current minus the comparison figure (money for money metrics, a whole number for counts)

pct.description: Percent of the comparison figure, one decimal; null when it was 0 (see kind)

kind.description: "new": there was nothing to compare with, show the word instead of a percent

tone.description: Whether this move is good news for this metric (more expenses is bad)
